source: live read-only chart fetch from nautilus-trader-india; eight concurrent requests tripped the per-second Data API limit. The endpoint returns candles and places no order.
why_it_matters: The only retryable outcome, and there is no Retry-After header to pace it. Tripped deliberately with eight concurrent chart reads; the message is longer than the one a prior repository had reconstructed by hand, which is the argument for capturing rather than writing fixtures.

body.errorMessage: Too many requests on server from single user breaching rate limits. Try throttling API calls.
